title: 953. Numbers With Same Consecutive Differences

examples.explanation: Only 181, 292, 707, 818 and 929 have every neighbouring digit pair differ by 7.
Sixteen two-digit numbers step by exactly 1 between their digits, from 10 up to 98.
Both digits must match, giving the nine repdigits 11 through 99.

hints: Extend each prefix only with last-digit plus/minus k, guarded to stay within 0..9.
When k is 0 the two extensions coincide — deduplicate to avoid double counting.
Handle single-digit answers (0 through 9) as a special case.
